## Data

Initially, I planned on using some state GIS portal roadway data with functional classes, but it turned out to be poorly suited for a routing topology. After investigating some sources with some AI help from Claude based on the specifications I gave, I've decided to pull roadway data from Overture since it's free and purpose-built for routing (at least in comparison to other free sources). Querying and initial prep is included below.

```{r get overture data}
# DB setup
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;")
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")

# Specify release
release <- "2026-09-23.1"  # or fetch dynamically — see note below

# Define bounding box around CT
bbox <- c(xmin = -73.75, ymin = 40.95, xmax = -71.75, ymax = 42.06)

# Define base path for pulling from overture
base_path <- sprintf("s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/%s/theme=transportation", release)

# Define classes to exclude
excluded_classes <- "'service', 'footway', 'path', 'steps', 'cycleway', 'pedestrian', 'bridleway', 'track'"
 

# Segments
## Query
segments_query <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    id,
    subtype,
    class,
    names,
    connectors,
    speed_limits,
    road_surface,
    access_restrictions,
    ST_AsText(geometry) AS geom_wkt
  FROM read_parquet(
    '%s/type=segment/*.parquet',
    hive_partitioning = 1
  )
  WHERE bbox.xmin < %f AND bbox.xmax > %f
    AND bbox.ymin < %f AND bbox.ymax > %f
    AND subtype = 'road'
    AND class NOT IN (%s)
", base_path, bbox['xmax'], bbox['xmin'], bbox['ymax'], bbox['ymin'], excluded_classes)
 
## Run query
segments_df <- dbGetQuery(con, segments_query)
segments_sf <- st_as_sf(segments_df, wkt = "geom_wkt", crs = 4326)
 
cat(sprintf("Pulled %d road segments (service + non-vehicular classes excluded)\n", nrow(segments_sf)))
 
# Connectors
## Query
connectors_query <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    id,
    ST_AsText(geometry) AS geom_wkt
  FROM read_parquet(
    '%s/type=connector/*.parquet',
    hive_partitioning = 1
  )
  WHERE bbox.xmin < %f AND bbox.xmax > %f
    AND bbox.ymin < %f AND bbox.ymax > %f
", base_path, bbox['xmax'], bbox['xmin'], bbox['ymax'], bbox['ymin'])
 
## Run query
connectors_df <- dbGetQuery(con, connectors_query)
connectors_sf <- st_as_sf(connectors_df, wkt = "geom_wkt", crs = 4326)
 
cat(sprintf("Pulled %d connectors\n", nrow(connectors_sf)))

# Close connection
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# Flatten
segments_flat <- segments_sf |>
  mutate(
    primary_name = names$primary,
    connector_ids = map_chr(connectors, \(x) {
      if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      paste(x$connector_id, collapse = ";")
    }),
    connector_positions = map_chr(connectors, \(x) {
      if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      paste(x$at, collapse = ";")
    }),
    n_midpoint_connectors = map_int(connectors, \(x) {
      if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(0L)
      sum(x$at > 0 & x$at < 1)
    }),
    speed_limit_mph = map_dbl(speed_limits, \(x) {
      if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      val <- tryCatch(x[[1]]$max_speed$value, error = \(e) NA_real_)
      if (is.null(val)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
    })
  ) |>
  select(-names, -connectors, -speed_limits, -access_restrictions)

## Flatten connectors and remove unused connectors
kept_connector_touches <- segments_flat |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(id, connector_ids) |>
  separate_longer_delim(connector_ids, delim = ";")
 
kept_connector_degree <- kept_connector_touches |>
  count(connector_ids, name = "kept_degree")
 
real_junction_ids <- kept_connector_degree |>
  filter(kept_degree >= 2) |>
  pull(connector_ids)
 
connectors_flat <- connectors_sf |>
  filter(id %in% real_junction_ids)
 
cat(sprintf("Connectors: %d in bbox -> %d are real junctions (2+ kept segments)\n",
            nrow(connectors_sf), nrow(connectors_flat)))

segments_flat <- segments_flat |>
  mutate(
    n_real_midpoint_connectors = map2_int(connector_ids, connector_positions, \(ids, positions) {
      if (is.na(ids) || is.na(positions)) return(0L)
      id_vec <- strsplit(ids, ";")[[1]]
      at_vec <- as.numeric(strsplit(positions, ";")[[1]])
      sum(id_vec %in% real_junction_ids & at_vec > 0 & at_vec < 1)
    })
  )
 
cat(sprintf("Segments needing splitting (real junctions only): %d of %d\n",
            sum(segments_flat$n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0),
            nrow(segments_flat)))

# # Write locally
# st_write(segments_flat, "overture_ct_segments.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE)
# st_write(connectors_flat_filtered, "overture_ct_connectors.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE)

## QAQC
# ---- 1. Manchester, CT bounding box --------------------------------------
manchester_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -72.587185, ymin = 41.752105, xmax = -72.456207, ymax = 41.831456),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
) |> st_as_sfc()

# ---- 2. Filter segments and connectors to the bbox -----------------------
manchester_segments <- segments_flat[st_intersects(segments_flat, manchester_bbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
manchester_connectors <- connectors_flat[st_intersects(connectors_flat, manchester_bbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
 
cat(sprintf("Manchester subset: %d segments, %d connectors\n",
            nrow(manchester_segments), nrow(manchester_connectors)))
cat(sprintf("  segments with mid-segment connectors: %d\n",
            sum(manchester_segments$n_midpoint_connectors > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
 
# ---- 3. Flag segments with mid-segment connectors for visual QA ----------
manchester_segments <- manchester_segments |>
  mutate(has_midpoint_connector = n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0)
 
# ---- 4. Plot: roads (flagged) + connectors ---------------------------------
manchester_map = mapview(
  manchester_segments,
  zcol = "has_midpoint_connector",
  color = list("grey40", "red"),
  lwd = 2,
  layer.name = "Roads (red = has mid-segment connector)"
) +
mapview(
  manchester_connectors,
  color = "blue",
  col.regions = "blue",
  cex = 3,
  layer.name = "Connectors"
)

## Additional checks
cat(sprintf("Empty geometries: %d\n", sum(st_is_empty(segments_flat$geom_wkt))))
cat(sprintf("Invalid geometries: %d\n", sum(!st_is_valid(segments_flat$geom_wkt[!st_is_empty(segments_flat$geom_wkt)])))) #no empty/invalid

segments_flat |>
  mutate(n_pts = mapply(function(g) nrow(st_coordinates(g)), geom_wkt)) |>
  filter(n_pts < 2) |>
  nrow() # 0

segments_flat |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0) |>
  mutate(
    at_vals = strsplit(connector_positions, ";") |> map(as.numeric),
    min_gap = map_dbl(at_vals, \(x) {
      xs <- sort(unique(x))
      if (length(xs) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      min(diff(xs))
    })
  ) |>
  filter(min_gap < 0.0001) |>
  nrow() # 0

segments_flat |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0) |>
  mutate(
    n_ids = lengths(strsplit(connector_ids, ";")),
    n_pos = lengths(strsplit(connector_positions, ";"))
  ) |>
  filter(n_ids != n_pos) |>
  nrow() # 0

segments_flat |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0) |>
  mutate(at_vals = strsplit(connector_positions, ";") |> map(as.numeric)) |>
  filter(map_lgl(at_vals, \(x) !(0 %in% x) || !(1 %in% x))) |>
  nrow() # 0


```

Now that I have my roadways (segments and connectors) pulled from Overture, I'll need to split roadways; unfortunately, much of this dataset (like many roadway datasets) have connectors in the middle of unsplit segments, providing no way to transfer between them in a routing topology. Splitting on these connectors will provide a cleaner web with all available connections.

```{r prep roads}

# Split segments with midpoint connectors
# ## Filter to Manchester to test before doing for whole state
# segments_flat = segments_flat[st_intersects(segments_flat, manchester_bbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
# connectors_flat = connectors_flat[st_intersects(connectors_flat, manchester_bbox, sparse = FALSE), ]

## Determine which need to be split vs dont
segments_to_split <- segments_flat |>
  filter(n_real_midpoint_connectors > 0)

segments_to_split |> st_geometry() |> st_geometry_type() |> table()

segments_to_split |>
  mutate(n_parts = lengths(st_geometry(segments_to_split))) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(n_parts)
 
segments_unchanged <- segments_flat |>
  filter(n_real_midpoint_connectors == 0)
 
cat(sprintf("Splitting %d segments, %d segments unchanged\n",
            nrow(segments_to_split), nrow(segments_unchanged)))
 
# ---- 2. Function to split a single segment's geometry at given break points -
split_one_segment <- function(geom, connector_ids_str, connector_positions_str) {
  id_vec <- strsplit(connector_ids_str, ";")[[1]]
  at_vec <- as.numeric(strsplit(connector_positions_str, ";")[[1]])

  split_at <- sort(unique(at_vec[id_vec %in% real_junction_ids & at_vec > 0 & at_vec < 1]))

  breaks <- c(0, split_at, 1)
  pieces <- vector("list", length(breaks) - 1)

  geom_sfc <- st_sfc(geom, crs = st_crs(segments_to_split))  # <- force to sfc

  for (i in seq_len(length(breaks) - 1)) {
    pieces[[i]] <- lwgeom::st_linesubstring(geom_sfc, breaks[i], breaks[i + 1])
  }

  piece_connectors <- vector("list", length(breaks) - 1)
  for (i in seq_len(length(breaks) - 1)) {
    start_id <- if (breaks[i] == 0) id_vec[at_vec == 0][1] else id_vec[at_vec == breaks[i]][1]
    end_id   <- if (breaks[i + 1] == 1) id_vec[at_vec == 1][1] else id_vec[at_vec == breaks[i + 1]][1]
    piece_connectors[[i]] <- paste(start_id, end_id, sep = ";")
  }

  list(geoms = pieces, connectors = piece_connectors)
}
 
## Apply the split itself
system.time({
  split_results <- segments_to_split |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(id, connector_ids, connector_positions) |>
  bind_cols(geometry = st_geometry(segments_to_split)) |>
  pmap(function(id, connector_ids, connector_positions, geometry) {
    split_one_segment(geometry, connector_ids, connector_positions)
  })
})

 
## Reebuild into SF again
split_segments_long <- map2_dfr(segments_to_split$id, split_results, \(seg_id, res) {
  n_pieces <- length(res$geoms)
  tibble(
    original_id = seg_id,
    piece_num = seq_len(n_pieces),
    new_connector_ids = unlist(res$connectors),  # this one is fine — plain character strings, not geometries
    geometry = st_sfc(do.call(c, res$geoms), crs = st_crs(segments_flat))
  )
}) |>
  st_as_sf()
 
## Join attributes back
segments_split_final <- split_segments_long |>
  left_join(
    segments_to_split |> st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(-connector_ids, -connector_positions, -n_real_midpoint_connectors) |>
      rename(original_id = id),
    by = "original_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    id = paste0(original_id, "_", piece_num),
    connector_ids = new_connector_ids,
    connector_positions = "0;1",
    n_real_midpoint_connectors = 0L  # by construction, no piece has a midpoint junction anymore
  ) |>
  select(-piece_num, -new_connector_ids)
 
segments_split_final <- segments_split_final |>
  rename(geom_wkt = geometry) |>
  st_set_geometry("geom_wkt")

stopifnot(attr(segments_unchanged, "sf_column") == attr(segments_split_final, "sf_column"))

## Clean up unchanged segment connector ids/positions
segments_unchanged_clean <- segments_unchanged |>
  mutate(
    kept_pairs = map2(connector_ids, connector_positions, \(ids, positions) {
      id_vec <- strsplit(ids, ";")[[1]]
      at_vec <- as.numeric(strsplit(positions, ";")[[1]])
      keep <- at_vec == 0 | at_vec == 1 | id_vec %in% real_junction_ids
      list(ids = id_vec[keep], at = at_vec[keep])
    }),
    connector_ids = map_chr(kept_pairs, \(x) paste(x$ids, collapse = ";")),
    connector_positions = map_chr(kept_pairs, \(x) paste(x$at, collapse = ";"))
  ) |>
  select(-kept_pairs)

### Average number of connectors per segment, before vs after
mean(lengths(strsplit(segments_unchanged$connector_ids, ";")))
mean(lengths(strsplit(segments_unchanged_clean$connector_ids, ";")))

### Other check
segments_unchanged_clean |> filter(connector_ids == "" | is.na(connector_ids)) |> nrow()

## Combine segments that didn't need to be split and split pieces back together
segments_final <- bind_rows(
  segments_unchanged_clean |> mutate(original_id = id),
  segments_split_final
)
 
cat(sprintf("Final segment count: %d (was %d before splitting)\n",
            nrow(segments_final), nrow(segments_flat)))
 
# Make final connectors so less missing
all_referenced_connector_ids <- segments_final |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  pull(connector_ids) |>
  strsplit(";") |>
  unlist() |>
  unique()

connectors_final <- connectors_sf |>
  filter(id %in% all_referenced_connector_ids)

cat(sprintf("Connectors: %d referenced by segments_final -> %d found in raw pull\n",
            length(all_referenced_connector_ids), nrow(connectors_final)))

# ---- 4. Plot: roads (flagged) + connectors ---------------------------------
checkbbox = st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -72.587185, ymin = 41.752105, xmax = -72.456207, ymax = 41.831456),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
) |> st_as_sfc()
segmentcheck = segments_final[st_intersects(segments_final, checkbbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
connectorcheck = connectors_final[st_intersects(connectors_final, checkbbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
  
  
segment_map_check = mapview(
  segmentcheck,
  color = "grey40",
  lwd = 2,
  layer.name = "Roads (red = has mid-segment connector)"
) +
mapview(
  connectorcheck,
  color = "blue",
  col.regions = "blue",
  cex = 3,
  layer.name = "Connectors"
)
```

 Finally, I'll be adding speed limits to roads so that routing will be at least somewhat closer to real world conditions. Decisions will be based on road class, taking definitions from OpenStreetMap documentation (one of the sources used in producing Overture), available here https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/United_States/Road_classification. I've also individually looked at the roadways included in each class by plotting them on a map so I can use a combination of CT speed limit guidelines and personal experience as a CT driver to determine speed limits to apply to each class. Decisions are as follows:

| Class | Description | Example(s) | Speed (mph) assigned |
| Motorway | Interstates, freeways, and other divided highways | I-95 | 60 |
| Trunk | Local, often rural highways | US-6 | 45 |
| Primary | State and local routes, major non-highway roads | Middle/Boston Turnpike in Manchester and Bolton | 35 |
| Secondary | Major local roads | Tolland Stage Rd in Tolland | 35 |
| Tertiary | Not quite major, not quite residential | Spruce St and Spring St in Manchester | 25 |
| Residential | Roads lined with residences not intended for significant through-traffic | EWestminster Rd in Manchester | 20 |
| Living Street | Few cases, roadways within complexes | N/A | 10 |
| Unclassified | Mostly roadways on campuses and military bases | N/A | 10 |
| Unknown | Mostly driveways, dead ends, etc | N/A | 10 |

```{r speed limits}
# Evaluate roadway segment types on which speed limits will be based
str(segments_final)
segments_final %>% group_by(class) %>% summarise(n = n())
segments_final %>% group_by(speed_limit_mph) %>% summarise(n = n())

# Add speed limits
## based on https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/United_States/Road_classification
### code to check road class
segment_map_check = mapview(
    segments_final %>% filter(class == "residential"),
    color = "grey40",
    lwd = 2,
    layer.name = "Roads (red = has mid-segment connector)"
)
segment_map_check

### assignment
segments_final = segments_final %>% 
  mutate(speed_limit_mph = case_when(
    class == "motorway" ~ 60,
    class == "trunk" ~ 45,
    class == "primary" ~ 35,
    class == "secondary" ~ 35,
    class == "tertiary" ~ 25,
    class == "residential" ~ 20,
    class == "unclassified" ~ 10, # mostly campuses and bases, leave low to discourage use
    class == "living_street" ~ 10, # mostly campuses and within complexes, leave low to discourage use
    class == "unknown" ~ 10 # mostly driveways, within complexes, etc., leave low to discourage use
  ))

### check
segments_final %>% group_by(speed_limit_mph) %>% summarise(n = n())

# Remove list column
segments_final = segments_final %>% 
  select(-c(road_surface))

# Write out shapes just in case needed
write_sf(segments_final, file.path('Overture Roads Outputs','Overture Segments.gpkg'), 'segments')
write_sf(connectors_final, file.path('Overture Roads Outputs','Overture Connectors.gpkg'), 'connectors')
```

## Shapefiles

Next, I'm going to work on prepping shapefiles for processing

```{r shapefiles}

# Pizza
## All pizza
all_pizza = all_pizza %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>% 
  mutate(name = paste0(Name, ", ", City)) %>% 
  mutate(address = str_replace(formatted_, ", [A-Z]{2}\\s+\\d{5},\\s+USA$", "")) %>% 
  mutate(address = case_when(
    unique_id == 1 ~ "1 Grigg St, Greenwich",
    unique_id == 89 ~ "27 Coogan Blvd Bldg 8, Mystic",
    unique_id == 59 ~ "22 Union City Rd, Prospect",
    unique_id == 5 ~ "2010 W Main St, Stamford",
    unique_id == 6 ~ "234 Stillwater Ave, Stamford",
    unique_id == 117 ~ "Tradewinds Plaza, 749 Saybrook Rd, Middletown",
    unique_id == 26 ~ "179 Union Ave, West Haven",
    .default = address
  )) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  select(unique_id, name, address, Type, apizza, greek, neapolitan, tavern, thick, geom) %>% 
  rename(pizza_id = unique_id) %>% 
  rename(type = Type) %>% 
  mutate(n_styles = rowSums(across(all_of(c("apizza", "greek", "neapolitan", "tavern", "thick"))), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(simple_type = case_when(n_styles > 1 ~ "Multiple styles",
                                 apizza == 1 ~ "New Haven style 'Apizza'",
                                 greek == 1 ~ "New England Greek pizza",
                                 neapolitan == 1 ~ "Neapolitan pizza",
                                 tavern == 1 ~ "Tavern style pizza",
                                 thick == 1 ~ "Thick crust pizza")) %>% 
  mutate(complete_type = case_when(n_styles == 1 ~ simple_type,
                                   n_styles == 3 ~ "New Haven style 'Apizza', Neapolitan pizza, and thick crust pizza",
                                   n_styles == 2 ~ "Neapolitan and thick crust pizza")) %>% 
  select(-c(n_styles, type, apizza, greek, neapolitan, thick, tavern))

    unique_id == 26 ~ "179 Union Ave, West Haven",
    .default = address
  )) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  select(unique_id, name, address, geom) %>% 
  rename(pizza_id = unique_id)
```

# Network prep

Here comes the fun part! Now that I've got all my files loaded in, I'll use dodgr to perform network analysis. I created a table of the census blocks with the five closest pizza joints in QGIS so I can limit the possibilities and I've made sure my road network has speed (and now a weighted distance based on that) to get closer to true travel times. 

```{r network}

# Work on edges/segments
edges_df = segments %>% 
  mutate(
    ## Add columns splitting the connector id column into start and end
    from_id = map_chr(connector_ids, \(x) strsplit(x, ";")[[1]][1]),
    to_id   = map_chr(connector_ids, \(x) {
      ids <- strsplit(x, ";")[[1]]
      ids[length(ids)]
    })
  ) %>% 
  ## rename to from and to for sfnetwork to work
  rename(from = from_id) %>% 
  rename(to = to_id)

# Work on nodes/connectors
nodes_df = connectors %>% 
  rename(node_id = id)

# Check before running
setdiff(c(edges_df$from, edges_df$to), nodes_df$node_id) |> unique() |> length()
missing_ids <- setdiff(c(edges_df$from, edges_df$to), nodes_df$node_id) |> unique()
# Are these NA, empty strings, or genuine-looking UUIDs?
head(missing_ids, 20)
sum(is.na(missing_ids))
sum(missing_ids == "")
## Plot for check
### Identify segments referencing a missing connector ID 
segments_missing_connectors <- segments_final |>
  filter(map_lgl(strsplit(connector_ids, ";"), \(ids) any(ids %in% missing_ids)))
cat(sprintf("Segments referencing a missing connector: %d\n",
            nrow(segments_missing_connectors)))
### Plot these segments against the full network for context
# mapview(
#   segments_final,
#   color = "grey70",
#   lwd = 1,
#   layer.name = "All segments"
# ) +
check3 = mapview(
  segments_missing_connectors,
  color = "red",
  lwd = 3,
  layer.name = "Segments with missing connector reference"
)
### Looks like it's all at the borders of the bbox
## Clean out edges
edges_df_clean = edges_df %>% 
  filter(!(from %in% missing_ids | to %in% missing_ids))
cat(sprintf("Edges: %d -> %d after dropping bbox-boundary artifacts (%d removed)\n",
            nrow(edges_df), nrow(edges_df_clean), nrow(edges_df) - nrow(edges_df_clean)))


# Prepare dodgr graph
## Get edges data set up correctly
edges_for_dodgr = edges_df_clean %>% 
  rename(from_id = from, to_id = to)

## Compute edge lengths and time to travel 
edges_for_dodgr <- edges_for_dodgr |>
  mutate(d = as.numeric(st_length(st_transform(edges_for_dodgr, 6433)))) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(d_weighted = d / (speed_limit_mph * 0.44704) / 60)
### Check
checkbbox = st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -72.587185, ymin = 41.752105, xmax = -72.456207, ymax = 41.831456),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
) |> st_as_sfc()
dodgredgescheck = edges_for_dodgr[st_intersects(edges_for_dodgr, checkbbox, sparse = FALSE), ]
dodgredgescheckmap = mapview(
  dodgredgescheck,
  color = "grey40",
  lwd = 2,
  layer.name = "Roads (red = has mid-segment connector)"
) 

## Build coord lookup from nodes so I can join coords onto dodgr edges graph
nodes_coords <- nodes_df |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(geom)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(geom)[, 2]) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(node_id, lon, lat)

## Join coords onto edges graph
edges_for_dodgr <- edges_for_dodgr |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  left_join(nodes_coords, by = c("from_id" = "node_id")) |>
  rename(from_lon = lon, from_lat = lat) |>
  left_join(nodes_coords, by = c("to_id" = "node_id")) |>
  rename(to_lon = lon, to_lat = lat) |>
  mutate(edge_id = row_number()) |>
  relocate(edge_id, .before = from_id)

## Check connectivity
### Define as result of dodgr components check
edges_connected_test <- dodgr_components(edges_for_dodgr)
### Divide into connected and disconnected
edges_connected <- edges_connected_test |> filter(component == 1)
edges_disconnect <- edges_connected_test |> filter(component != 1)
cat(sprintf("Edges: %d total -> %d in main component, %d disconnected\n",
            nrow(edges_connected_test), nrow(edges_connected), nrow(edges_disconnect)))
### Plot disconnected
#### Join geometries back onto disconnected edges
disconnect_sf <- edges_disconnect |>
  left_join(
    segments_final |> select(id, geom_wkt),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()
#### Confirm the join worked and geometry is real
nrow(disconnect_sf)
sum(st_is_empty(st_geometry(disconnect_sf)))  # should be 0
#### Plot
disconnect_check = mapview(disconnect_sf, color = "red", lwd = 2, layer.name = "Disconnected edges")
##### Random paths off the road network (unclassified roads within parking lots, for example) plus Long Island, good to remove

## Discard disconnected edges and make edges graph birdirectional
### Make reversed copy
reverse_edges <- edges_connected |>
  rename(
    from_id = to_id, to_id = from_id,
    from_lon = to_lon, to_lon = from_lon,
    from_lat = to_lat, to_lat = from_lat
  )
### Combine both directions
edges_bidirectional <- bind_rows(edges_connected, reverse_edges) |>
  distinct(from_id, to_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Final checks before network
### Check how many discarded
cat(sprintf("Keeping %d of %d edges (%.1f%% of network)\n",
            nrow(edges_connected), nrow(edges_connected_test),
            100 * nrow(edges_connected) / nrow(edges_connected_test)))
### Map largest groups
top_disconnected <- edges_connected_test |>
  filter(component %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)) |>
  left_join(segments_final |> select(id, geom_wkt), by = "id") |>
  st_as_sf()
topdisconnectedmap = mapview(top_disconnected, zcol = "component", lwd = 3)
#### All long island
### Map all disconnected edges
li_check <- edges_disconnect |>
  left_join(segments_final |> select(id, geom_wkt), by = "id") |>
  st_as_sf()
licheckmap = mapview(li_check, zcol = "component", lwd = 2)
#### all good
```

# Network Analysis

Now that the graph is prepped, I can go into actually computing the distances between places from the table!

After putting together a test run of 1000 randomly sampled rows, I wrote out the resulting table with its coordinates to check out the real drive times per online mapping tools. After obtaining the travel times for each of the coordinate pairs via Google Maps (using the guidance provided [here](https://medium.com/@omniview/using-google-apps-scripts-to-calculate-realtime-driving-distance-time-33e58cdd54d7)), I calculated a correction for each row (Google Maps trip time divided by network analysis trip time), broke the network analysis trip times into quintiles, found the boundaries of those quintiles, and calculated an average correction for each group so that I could calculate more realistic travel times for each pair without resorting to nearly 300,000 individual routing requests.

```{r network analysis all}

# Prepare edges 
edges_bidirectional = edges_bidirectional %>% 
  rename(time_weighted = d_weighted) %>% 
  mutate(time = time_weighted)
## Clean up structure a bit
edges_bidirectional = edges_bidirectional %>% 
  select(c(edge_id, to_id, from_id, to_lat, to_lon, from_lat, from_lon, d, time_weighted, time))

# Guard against key problems that would silently break alignment
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(census_blocks_centeroid$GEOIDFQ),
  !anyDuplicated(all_pizza$pizza_id),
  !anyDuplicated(blocks_all[c("GEOIDFQ", "pizza_id")])
)

# Coordinate lookups, keyed (select only what you need so Name doesn't collide)
block_xy = census_blocks_centeroid %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(census_blocks_centeroid)) %>%
  select(GEOIDFQ, o_x = X, o_y = Y)

pizza_xy = all_pizza %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(all_pizza)) %>%
  select(pizza_id, d_x = X, d_y = Y)

# One row per block-shop pair, coordinates attached by key
pairs_all = blocks_all %>%
  left_join(block_xy, by = "GEOIDFQ") %>%
  left_join(pizza_xy, by = "pizza_id")

stopifnot(nrow(pairs_all) == nrow(blocks_all),
          !anyNA(pairs_all[c("o_x", "o_y", "d_x", "d_y")]))

# Matrices come from the table, so row i of each belongs to row i of pairs
origin_coords_all = as.matrix(pairs_all[c("o_x", "o_y")]); colnames(origin_coords_all) = c("x", "y")
dest_coords_all   = as.matrix(pairs_all[c("d_x", "d_y")]); colnames(dest_coords_all)   = c("x", "y")

# Verify CRS
st_crs(census_blocks_centeroid)
st_crs(all_pizza)
st_crs(edges_df_clean)
st_crs(edges_df_clean) == st_crs(census_blocks_centeroid)
st_crs(edges_df_clean) == st_crs(all_pizza)

# Verify bounding box
st_bbox(all_pizza)
st_bbox(edges_df_clean)
st_bbox(census_blocks_centeroid)

# Verify numbers
nrow(origin_coords_all) == nrow(dest_coords_all)  # required for pairwise = TRUE
sum(is.na(origin_coords_all))  # any unmatched GEOID20 in the join?
sum(is.na(dest_coords_all))    # any unmatched pizza_id?

# Test run, first and last row of edges
test_from <- matrix(c(edges_bidirectional$from_lon[1], edges_bidirectional$from_lat[1]), nrow = 1)
colnames(test_from) = c("x", "y")
test_to <- matrix(c(edges_bidirectional$to_lon[5000], edges_bidirectional$to_lat[5000]), nrow = 1)
colnames(test_to) = c("x", "y")
## to is 40.95119, -73.72723, near mamaroneck
## from is 41.02752, -73.68818, on merritt just over NY state line
## Test the distances
dodgr_times(edges_bidirectional, from = test_from, to = test_to, pairwise = TRUE)

# Test on 500 random pairs before the full run
set.seed(42)
idx = sample(nrow(pairs_all), 1000)
test_times = dodgr_times(edges_bidirectional,
                         from = origin_coords_all[idx, ], to = dest_coords_all[idx, ],
                         pairwise = TRUE)
summary(as.numeric(test_times))   # plausible values? any NA?
## Check
test_out = pairs_all[idx, ] %>% mutate(time_test = as.numeric(test_times))
write_clip(test_out)

# Full run
all_pizza_times = dodgr_times(edges_bidirectional, from = origin_coords_all,
                          to = dest_coords_all, pairwise = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(all_pizza_times) == nrow(pairs_all))  # catches an unexpected N x N result

pairs_all$time_min = as.numeric(all_pizza_times)   # name the column with its units


# Correction for times
pairs_all = pairs_all %>% 
  mutate(time_corrected = case_when(
    time_min < 8.41 ~ time_min*1.976,
    time_min >= 8.417 & time_min < 15.116 ~ time_min*1.399,
    time_min >= 15.116 & time_min < 22.648 ~ time_min*1.232,
    time_min >= 22.648 & time_min < 35.232 ~ time_min*1.187,
    time_min >= 35.232 ~ time_min*1.074
  ))
```

```{r network analysis greek}
nrow(origin_coords_greek) == nrow(dest_coords_greek)  # required for pairwise = TRUE
sum(is.na(origin_coords_greek))  # any unmatched GEOID20 in the join?
sum(is.na(dest_coords_greek))    # any unmatched pizza_id?

# Full run
greek_times = dodgr_times(edges_bidirectional, from = origin_coords_greek,
                          to = dest_coords_greek, pairwise = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(greek_times) == nrow(pairs_greek))  # catches an unexpected N x N result

pairs_greek$time_min = as.numeric(greek_times)   # name the column with its units


# Correction for times
pairs_greek = pairs_greek %>% 
  mutate(time_corrected = case_when(
    time_min < 8.41 ~ time_min*1.976,
    time_min >= 8.417 & time_min < 15.116 ~ time_min*1.399,
    time_min >= 15.116 & time_min < 22.648 ~ time_min*1.232,
    time_min >= 22.648 & time_min < 35.232 ~ time_min*1.187,
    time_min >= 35.232 ~ time_min*1.074
  ))
```

```{r final leaflet}
# API for map baselayer
carto_key <- Sys.getenv("CARTO_MAPS_API_KEY")


# Create leaflet map
## Define layer groups
layer_pairs = list(
  "All Pizza Trail Pizza Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_all_dissolved, shops = all_pizza),
  "New Haven Style 'Apizza' Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_apizza_dissolved, shops = apizza),
  "New England Greek Style Pizza Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_greek_dissolved, shops = greek),
  "Neapolitan Style Pizza Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_neapolitan_dissolved, shops = neapolitan),
  "Tavern Style Pizza Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_tavern_dissolved, shops = tavern),
  "Thick Crust Pizza Shops" = list(zones = census_blocks_thick_dissolved, shops = thick)
)


## Define specific pizza icon
pizza_icon = makeAwesomeIcon(
  text = "🍕"
)

white_halo = paste("-1.5px -1.5px 0 white", " 1.5px -1.5px 0 white",
                   "-1.5px  1.5px 0 white", " 1.5px  1.5px 0 white",
                   " 0px -1.5px 0 white", " 0px  1.5px 0 white",
                   "-1.5px  0px 0 white", " 1.5px  0px 0 white",
                   sep = ", ")

## Define emoji label options
emoji_opts = labelOptions(
  noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", textOnly = TRUE,
  style = list("font-size" = "20px", "text-shadow" = white_halo)
)

## Define popups
esc = \(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(x), ""))

make_popup = function(d, include_style = FALSE) {
  txt = sprintf("<b>Name:</b> %s<br><b>Address:</b> %s", esc(d$name), esc(d$address))
  if (include_style) {
    txt = paste0(txt, sprintf("<br><b>Style:</b> %s", esc(d$complete_type)))
  }
  txt
}

## Build palette
### neighbor-coloring as a function so can apply to each layer
color_zones = function(zones) {
  zones = zones
  nb = st_intersects(zones)
  nb = lapply(seq_along(nb), \(i) setdiff(nb[[i]], i))
  ord = order(lengths(nb), decreasing = TRUE)
  col_id = rep(NA_integer_, nrow(zones))
  for (i in ord) {
    used = col_id[nb[[i]]]
    col_id[i] = min(setdiff(seq_len(length(nb[[i]]) + 1), used))
  }
  zones$col_id = col_id
  zones
}

### apply the zones to each layer set
layer_pairs = lapply(layer_pairs, \(s) { s$zones = color_zones(s$zones); s })

### create palette that covers all
k = max(sapply(layer_pairs, \(s) max(s$zones$col_id)))
k                                  # how many colors the worst set needed
stopifnot(k <= 8)                  # Set2 tops out at 8 colors

pal = colorFactor(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Pastel1")[seq_len(k)],
                  domain = seq_len(k))


## Build map
leaflet_map_overall = leaflet() %>% 
  ### Extent: 
  setView(-72.6915, 41.6032, 9) %>%
  ### Base: based on [this site](https://leaflet-extras.github.io/leaflet-providers/preview/index.html) I like Stadia Outdoors best (among free, no registration options)
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = paste0("https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
    attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://openstreetmap.org">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com">CARTO</a>'
  )
  
for (nm in names(layer_pairs)) {
  s = layer_pairs[[nm]]
  leaflet_map_overall = leaflet_map_overall %>%
    ### Add polygons for each zone group
    addPolygons(data = s$zones, group = nm,
                fillColor = ~pal(col_id), fillOpacity = 0.5,
                color = "grey", weight = 0.5, label = ~name,
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3)) %>%
    ### emoji with white halo
    addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = s$shops, group = nm,
                        label = rep("🍕", nrow(s$shops)),
                        labelOptions = emoji_opts) %>%
    ### invisible hit area carrying the shop-name hover label
    addCircleMarkers(data = s$shops, group = nm, radius = 10,
                     stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0, label = ~name,
                     popup = make_popup(s$shops, include_style = (nm == "All Pizza Trail Pizza Shops")))
}
### make it so that only one set of layers shows upn at a time
leaflet_map_overall = leaflet_map_overall %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = names(layer_pairs),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  hideGroup(names(layer_pairs)[-1])
```

```{r leaflet corrected vs raw comparison}

# Create leaflet map
## Define layer groups
layer_pairs_apizza_comp = list(
  "Apizza with Raw Times" = list(zones = census_blocks_apizza_dissolved, shops = apizza),
  "Apizza with Corrected Times" = list(zones = census_blocks_apizza_dissolved_corrected_time, shops = apizza)
)

## Build palette
### neighbor-coloring as a function so can apply to each layer
#### Already defined in previous block

### apply the zones to each layer set
layer_pairs_apizza_comp = lapply(layer_pairs_apizza_comp, \(s) { s$zones = color_zones(s$zones); s })

### create palette that covers all
k = max(sapply(layer_pairs_apizza_comp, \(s) max(s$zones$col_id)))
k                                  # how many colors the worst set needed
stopifnot(k <= 8)                  # Set2 tops out at 8 colors

pal = colorFactor(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Pastel1")[seq_len(k)],
                  domain = seq_len(k))


## Build map
leaflet_map_apizza_comp = leaflet() %>% 
  ### Extent: 
  setView(-72.6915, 41.6032, 9) %>%
  ### Base: based on [this site](https://leaflet-extras.github.io/leaflet-providers/preview/index.html) I like Stadia Outdoors best (among free, no registration options)
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = paste0("https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
    attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://openstreetmap.org">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com">CARTO</a>'
  )

for (nm in names(layer_pairs_apizza_comp)) {
  s = layer_pairs_apizza_comp[[nm]]
  leaflet_map_apizza_comp = leaflet_map_apizza_comp %>%
    ### Add polygons for each zone group
    addPolygons(data = s$zones, group = nm,
                fillColor = ~pal(col_id), fillOpacity = 0.5,
                color = "grey", weight = 0.5, label = ~name,
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3)) %>%
    ### emoji with white halo
    addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = s$shops, group = nm,
                        label = rep("🍕", nrow(s$shops)),
                        labelOptions = emoji_opts) %>%
    ### invisible hit area carrying the shop-name hover label
    addCircleMarkers(data = s$shops, group = nm, radius = 10,
                     stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0, label = ~name,
                     popup = make_popup(s$shops, include_style = (nm == "All Pizza Trail Pizza Shops")))
}
### make it so that only one set of layers shows upn at a time
leaflet_map_apizza_comp = leaflet_map_apizza_comp %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = names(layer_pairs_apizza_comp),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  hideGroup(names(layer_pairs_apizza_comp)[-1])


# Write out leaflet map
saveWidget(leaflet_map_apizza_comp,
           file = paste0(output_dir, "/Pizza Trail Apizza Comparison Leaflet Map.html"),
           selfcontained = FALSE,
           title = "CT Pizza Trail Time Comparison Map",
           libdir = "map_assets")
```
